build.genericFrame: The theme {theme} has no design for “{element}”, so it is drawn in a plain frame.
build.emptyElement: {element} is empty, so it prints only its label.
fit.dice: {dice} is not a die of {system}, so it prints as plain text. Change it to a die {system} uses.
fit.fields: This creature has values {system} does not use ({fields}). They stay in the text but do not print; move them into {system}'s stats.
fit.element: {system} does not turn on “{element}”. It stays in the text as written.
fit.codexType: The codex keeps its {type} entries ({count}), but {system} has no such type.
build.brokenReference: The codex has no entry “{entry}”; “?” is printed instead.
build.missingTranslation: {language} lacks {count} printed words of {module} ({words}); they print in English.
map.lowResolution: The map “{map}” is only {dpi} dpi at its printed size. Print needs 300 dpi.
paper.coloured: The paper style “{paper}” of the theme {theme} colours the sheet. Handout paper must stay white.
paper.tooDark: The stains of the paper style “{paper}” of the theme {theme} are too dark to print lightly.
handout.long: Handout {number} needs {sheets} sheets in the player PDF: unusually long for something handed to players.
preflight.noSwedish: The font {font} has no å, ä or ö.
preflight.lowResolution: The image {image} prints at only {dpi} dpi; 300 dpi or more prints sharply.
preflight.noImageDescription: The image {image} has no description for screen readers.
preflight.noMapDescription: The map {map} has no description for screen readers.
preflight.portraitLowResolution: The portrait of {person} prints at only {dpi} dpi; 300 dpi or more prints sharply.
preflight.noPortraitDescription: The portrait of {person} has no description for screen readers.
heading.skipsLevel: The heading “{title}” skips a level: it is a Sub-heading {from} with no Sub-heading {sub} above it in its scene. Raise it to Sub-heading {sub}.
